Hanging the banners…

Threads in the Wind Embroideries from Gaza

Seven embroidered banners

Cross-stitch pieces made by Palestinian women in refugee camps and the occupied territories, photographed at an exhibition. Drag to look around, pinch or scroll to zoom, tap a banner to bring it forward.

Install on iPhone or iPad

In Safari, tap the Share button, then Add to Home Screen. The banners then open full-screen from your home screen, and work offline.
